independent_checks.result: Condition the central triangle first. Its block is36I-8J. The component diagonal Schur block becomes27I-9C-(9/4)F+(3/4)J, while the cross-component block acts only on the two fiber-contrast directions. In normalized fiber coordinates, each diagonal contrast block is27/2 and the cross block is-27/2. Eliminating the first component therefore subtracts(9/4)F-(3/4)J from the second block. The result is exactly T=27I-9C2-(9/2)F+(3/2)J. The zero fiber-constant direction is discarded compatibly; no inverse of a singular full block is assumed.
